scope: Read-only exact diff and installed Uvicorn scope review. Proposals unapplied at inspection; no workloads run by reviewer.

conclusions.detail: Existing SelectorEventLoop instance factory unchanged. Proposal extracts identical platform-selection expression into local_loop returning the factory import string on win32 and auto elsewhere; ui_session passes identical selected loop.

Proposal only imports shared local_loop inside serve and passes loop=local_loop to existing uvicorn.run. Settings/project root, local_url loopback check, host/port and all other default parameters unchanged. No reload/workers/daemon feature added.
local_url already imports hosting before serving; new local helper import does not add hosting initialization to other CLI commands or meaningful new module initialization to serve.
App source unchanged, including TrustedHost middleware, loopback client/origin checks, operator token authorization and WebSocket handling. Session ownership/shutdown timers unchanged.

uvicorn_evidence.scope: uvicorn.run defaults reload=False, workers=None; WEB_CONCURRENCY may alter workers, but workers>1 with existing non-string app instance fails at main.py603-607 before serving. Existing pyproject minimum>=0.36 covers custom loop factory support.

limitations: Windows Selector socket count limit and lack of async subprocess/pipe support remain confined to the local socket-only ASGI host; independent SDK/harness worker asyncio runners and process-wide policy are unchanged. No new async subprocess work on this host loop found.

Prior owned-session controlled reset probe established factory behavior, not completion of CLI-specific or all browser acceptance cases. Planned Windows/non-Windows mocked serve seam checks remain required for new applied delta evidence.
No production application, qualification, artifact, performance, browser deadline or release readiness claim. This review is narrowly for the exact two unapplied proposals.
